source:
@@U01356@@
Who cares? Sign it and you're done with it.

@@U01358@@
If this is the way you operate, your scheme’s as well as done itself in.

@@U01360@@
Ah, the sanctity of the man! It’s you all over! It’s the first time, is it, you've borne false witness? You haven't, I suppose, with your oh so great and mighty powers, propounded definitions of God and the world and the forces that move it at its inmost core, of man and man’s heart, man’s head and soul, and what goes on there? Done so, I dare say, without a qualm or a blush? And yet, if you looked deep and hard in your own soul you'd have to confess you knew as much about that as you know of 施韦尔特莱因’s death.

@@U01362@@
Sophist and liar you are and always will be!

@@U01364@@
Yes, well; at least I won't be lonely. For tomorrow, in all sincerity, you'll be proving our little 格蕾琴 a fool with vows of love and other such nonsense.

@@U01366@@
Yes, and with all my heart!
translation:
@@U01356@@
谁在乎？签名后就完成了。

@@U01358@@
如果这就是你的运作方式，那么你的计划也就成功了。

@@U01360@@
啊，男人的神圣！全部都是你了！你这是第一次作假见证吧？我想，你还没有以你如此伟大和强大的力量，提出上帝和世界的定义，以及推动世界最深处的力量，人和人的心，人的头脑和灵魂，以及那里发生了什么？我敢说，这样做时没有任何疑虑或脸红吗？然而，如果你深入审视自己的灵魂，你就不得不承认，你对此事的了解和对施韦尔特莱因之死的了解一样多。

@@U01362@@
你现在是，而且永远都是诡辩家和骗子！

@@U01364@@
是的，好吧；至少我不会孤单。明天，真诚地，你将用爱的誓言和其他诸如此类的废话来证明我们的小格蕾琴是个傻瓜。

@@U01366@@
是的，我全心全意！
